==Description==
'''Coordination''' is a buff that boosts damage of the [[Operator]] tower.

==Mechanics==
'''Coordination''' boosts the damage of a tower similarly to the [[Damage Buff]]. This buff is currently exclusive to the [[Operator]] tower. If an [[Operator]] is within the '''Coordination''' range of another [[Operator]], they will gain the buff. It also does not visibly increase the damage on the upgrade menu statistics.

==Applied By==
The following towers can apply '''Coordination''' to other towers:
*[[Operator]] (Passive)
